description: Menu item — a ghost row inside a floating menu. Rests transparent, rides the neutral ghost ladder (hover step 3, active step 4), and SELECTED flips hue: the accent ghost-selected rung (accent step 4) + accent text — same lightness rung as active, different hue, so a hovered neighbour and the chosen item can never be confused (December's selected ≡ hover leak, closed by the selected rung, 2026-08-30). Height is never stated: inset × 2 + cap(label).
notes: Selected styles :is([aria-selected='true'], [aria-checked='true']): aria-selected for option-in-listbox use, aria-checked for menuitemradio/menuitemcheckbox (aria-selected is INVALID on plain menuitem, axe aria-allowed-attr, caught by the 2026-09-08 accessibility sweep; v0.3.1 declares both so the emitter honours the platform's vocabulary). The styling hook stays an ARIA attribute, never a class. No selected-hover: a chosen item is state, not affordance. v0.2.0: Label ink nudged strong → SUBTLE (2026-09-05, Victor — 'will look better'): menu labels are SCANNED (md compressed), floor Lc 60; measured live via apca-w3: subtle at rest = 84.7 light / −86.1 dark on surface, −69.1 on the dark floating panel (the tightest real case, above the floor); hover 67/−69. Selected keeps text-accent-strong — the 60.4 corner never occurs. Accepted trade: label and icon now share step 12, flattening the strong-text/subtle-icon hierarchy for nav rows — quieter chrome, deliberate. v0.3.0 (2026-09-05, Victor): radius REMOVED — menu items are square, spanning the panel's full width edge to edge; the MENU owns the rounding (its corners + the bleed guard keep item fills clear of them). A rounded item inside a rounded panel was double-dressing.

aria.aria-selected: reflects the chosen item when the role supports selection (option in a listbox)
aria.aria-checked: reflects the chosen item as menuitemradio/menuitemcheckbox — aria-selected is invalid on plain menuitem, so persistent choice inside role=menu uses the radio/checkbox roles
